purpose: One versioned correctness repair for complete priority-pose preservation, evaluated on a fresh holdout before any v2 outcomes are observed.

repair_scope.changed: At full interval priority frames, all 23 captured hierarchy rotations are exact derived constraints. The 17 semantic joints remain the only direct animator controls at partial frames.
repair_scope.unchanged: Model family, width, dilations, dropout, local-state representation, boundary context, loss weights, optimizer, contact ablation, model input width and runtime boundary.

data.development_contact: Always unknown; no hidden target contact input or contact loss.

optimization.selection: Lowest aggregate unknown-contact v2 development loss after at least six epochs; detailed frozen cohort gates remain separate.

contact_ablation.unknown_contact: Zero all contact inputs and contact loss during training.
contact_ablation.weak_contact: Use confidence-weighted train-only heuristic foot contacts with 50 percent per-example contact-input dropout.
contact_ablation.promotion: Unknown mode may qualify independently. Weak mode requires both seeds and measurable contact benefit without non-contact regression.

hard_stops: Do not use the exposed v1 development cohort to select v2.
Do not make another TCN representation, seed, loss or hyperparameter repair after v2 outcomes.
If v2 fails frozen quality cohorts, advance to the distinct diffusion family or improve independently sourced evidence.
Do not export or promote before detailed quality, ONNX parity, Bforartists latency, rig lifecycle and animator comparison pass.
